svg.aria-label: One founder, a team of AI agents. Spec: I decide what to build and write it down. AI agents: Claude Code writes most of the code. Tests: 240+ end-to-end tests on a copy of the database. Review: I read every change before it ships. Deploy: Every push goes live automatically.
